title: FLA import: CPicButton trackAsMenu skipped; button sounds (up/over/down states) not decoded
description:
readCPicButton() in flash8-binary.ts skips two things:

1. trackAsMenu (line 1674: r.skip(1)) — this flag makes the button behave like a menu item (press = click, drag-out stays active). Skipping it causes imported buttons to have wrong click behavior.

2. Button per-state sounds — the FLA stores up-to-4 sound attachments on each button symbol (roll-over, roll-out, press, release). These are NOT in CPicButton (they live in the symbol-level CPicPage or a separate Sound substream). The SWF model (ButtonSounds) and SWF encoder (encodeDefineButtonSound, tag 17) are already implemented (task 0856 done), but FLA import never populates them.

Steps:
1. Read the trackAsMenu byte in readCPicButton() and store it in Fla8Instance (add a trackAsMenu field)
2. Forward trackAsMenu to the SymbolItem in flash8-import.ts
3. Research where button per-state sounds live in the FLA binary (flacomdoc, fla-decoder), decode them in parseFla8Timeline or readCPicButton, and wire them to the model's ButtonSounds field.
